prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” marketing agency for everyone — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and preferred services (SEO, PPC, branding, social, B2B, etc.). I can help narrow it down — but first a few quick questions:

- What services do you need (SEO, paid media, social, branding, web design, full-service)?  
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget range?  
- Are you targeting local Maryland customers, regional (Mid-Atlantic), or national audiences?  
- Do you prefer a small local shop, a mid-sized specialist, or a larger/full-service agency?  
- Any industries you want the agency to have experience in (healthcare, tech, legal, hospitality, nonprofits)?

How I can help next
- If you answer those, I’ll shortlist 4–7 Maryland agencies that fit your needs (with why each might be a good match).  
- Or I can give a generic shortlist of top-rated Maryland agencies and how they differ.

Quick tips to pick the right agency (use this checklist when evaluating)
1. Fit to goals: Do they specialize in the service you need?  
2. Industry experience: Have they generated measurable results for similar businesses? Ask for case studies with metrics.  
3. References: Request and call 2–3 recent clients.  
4. Transparency: Do they provide clear pricing, scope, timelines, and reporting cadence?  
5. Team & tools: Who will work on your account and what platforms/tools do they use?  
6. Measurable KPIs: Are expectations and success metrics defined (leads, CAC, MQLs, traffic, conversion rates)?  
7. Contract flexibility: Minimum term, exit clauses, deliverable guarantees.  
8. Culture & communication: Are response times and meeting cadences acceptable?

Questions to ask an agency in your first call
- What measurable results did you get for a client like me? Can you show the case study?  
- Who will be my day-to-day contact and can I meet them?  
- Which channels do you recommend first and why?  
- How do you measure ROI and how often will you report?  
- What is your pricing model (retainer, project, % ad spend)?  
- What’s the typical onboarding timeline and deliverables in the first 90 days?

Resources to find & compare Maryland agencies
- Clutch.co, UpCity, DesignRush (agency directories and reviews)  
- Google Maps/Business profiles and LinkedIn company pages  
- Local publications: Baltimore Business Journal, Washington Business Journal for awards and profiles

If you want, tell me the answers to the short questions above and I’ll recommend a tailored shortlist of highly rated Maryland agencies and why each might be right for you.
